subject: Request: POC fuel reserve for throughput soak - Sable Health
messages:
From: Michael He <michael.he@sablehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+load@sablehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC run: request for short-term credits for 48h throughput soak

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to run a 48-hour throughput soak in our preprod environment to validate end-to-end latency under sustained load. The plan below is what our infra team will execute:

- Duration: 48 hours starting Friday 02:00 UTC
- Expected sustained traffic: ~15k reqs/hour (peak ~22k)
- Payloads are small (avg 450 tokens) but KV cache warm-up will require repeated prefixes

Can Redwood provision a short-term credit reserve/allowance to cover the POC run? We estimate ~75k token-equivalent credits but would prefer if you can propose a safe buffer. Attached is the traffic-matrix.csv with the hourly profile.

Also confirm we can spike briefly to 28k reqs/hr if we need to validate autoscaling. No sensitive data will be sent — we will use synthetic payloads.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our stakeholders want results early next week.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael He
Head of Platform Engineering | Sable Health
[Attachment: traffic-matrix.csv]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Michael He <michael.he@sablehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC run: request for short-term credits for 48h throughput soak

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the details and the traffic matrix. That helps a lot. Quick notes:

- We can provide a provisional promotional credit reserve to cover the 48h soak and a safety buffer for brief spikes.
- Can you confirm the goal: are you validating latency SLOs at sustained throughput, or are you running functional stress tests for error-rate analysis? (We handle both but allocate credits slightly differently.)

In the meantime I've looped in Ben (Sales) and Priya (Solutions) to review the request and propose a credit amount and any contractual notes. Priya — attaching a short POC plan we discussed; feel free to edit and we can send a single doc to Sable.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to propose provisional credit amount and approval path.
2) Sable confirms exact start window and any requested SLA or retention constraints.
3) We provision credits and share a dashboard link + playbook for throttling/fallback.

Attaching a short poc-plan.pdf that outlines our preferred runbook.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc-plan.pdf]

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Michael He <michael.he@sablehealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Hannah,
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to run a 48-hour throughput soak in our preprod environment to validate end-to-end latency under sustained load....

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Michael He <michael.he@sablehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC run: request for short-term credits for 48h throughput soak

Hi team —

Thanks for the context, Hannah and Michael. I've reviewed the traffic profile. Given the 48h window and the expected token burn, I'm comfortable approving a provisional credit reserve to cover up to ~100k token-equivalent usage (this includes a 30% buffer for spikes). This will be issued as a time-limited promotional allowance tied to deal SB-2026-0421.

A few operational notes before we provision:
- We need an explicit start and end timestamp to set the allowance window (please confirm UTC).
- We'll include a short acceptance clause: any usage beyond the allowance will be billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates unless we agree to an extension.
- For regulated customers like Sable Health, we'll confirm that no PHI is used in the POC traffic and that data retention is set to 24 hours for logs.

If that sounds good, Hannah — can you confirm the start time and sign-off? I'll route the promo credit and send the dashboard link and throttling playbook.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Michael He <michael.he@sablehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+load@sablehealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC run: request for short-term credits for 48h throughput soak

Ben, Hannah —

Thanks, that's perfect. Confirming our start: Friday 2026-11-14 02:00 UTC to Sunday 2026-11-16 02:00 UTC. We accept the provisional 100k-token credit reserve with the 30% buffer and the standard overage billing clause. We will use synthetic payloads, no PHI.

Please provision the allowance and share the dashboard and playbook so our infra team can hook up the load generator. We'll monitor and report any anomalous error patterns immediately.

Attachments: final-run-window.txt (included inline)

Appreciate the quick support — excited to validate latency under load.

—Michael
Michael He
Head of Platform Engineering | Sable Health
